description:
Full Stack Developer
 Location: Chantilly, VA
 Must have an active TS/SCI FS Poly
 Looking for a full stack developer supporting a backend development team focused on middleware and backend services.
 Requirements 
 Required Skills:
 Intermediate to Expert level experience in Solr or Elastic Search (minimum 3 years)
 a. Performing schema updates
 b. Possessing significant knowledge & experience in submitting Lucene queries
 c. Possessing significant knowledge & experience on how Solr/Elastic shards work
 d. Possessing significant experience tuning Solr/Elastic for performance and query optimization
 Minimum of 3 years of experience in a big data environment using tools such as Hadoop, Pyspark, Spark, and Hbase (prefer at least two of the list)
 Minimum of 5 years of hands-on, back-end Java development experience (not Javascript or Springboot) implementing code that undergoes code reviews, unit testing, integration testing and deployed to a production environment
 College degree in Computer Science or equivalent technical degree 
 
 Optional Skills:
 • Demonstrated experience working with several AWS services.
 • Demonstrated experience with JIRA and GITHUB.
 Benefits 
 We are proud to offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to include
 Medical 
 Dental
 Vision
 Basic Life 
 Health Saving Account
 401K matching
 Three weeks of PTO/Sick
 11 Paid Holidays
 Pre-Approved Online Training
